rows.quote: The publicly available R10 data from the FinnGen study comprised 4620 patients with VTE and 356,574 healthy controls.[21] In contrast, the VTE-related GWAS data from the UK Biobank, obtained from Neale labs, consisted of 4620 cases and 356,574 controls, encompassing 11,901,177 SNPs, and utilizing the disease code ukb-d-I9_VTE (https://gwas.mrcieu.ac.uk/).
rows.coder_note: The sentence names 'R10 data from the FinnGen study'; the 4620 cases and 356,574 controls are endpoint counts, below the R10 release N and equal to no other FinnGen release N, so not a conflict under rule H; no other FinnGen release is named in the passages.

p003 gives the accession ukb-d-I9_VTE, inside the ukb-d range registered to the MRC-IEU UK Biobank pipeline row, but attributes the data to Neale labs and gives 4620 cases and 356,574 controls, the whole GWAS sample of 361,194, which is the Neale lab round 2 release N and neither N of the MRC-IEU row (rules H and I3); the identifiers point to two rows.
